subject.title: Control UI chat markdown only renders data URI images, not remote https image URLs

question: Should Control UI render remote http/https Markdown image URLs directly from chat content, and if so under what trust policy?
rationale: Current source, tests, docs, and prior hardening intentionally prevent remote browser image fetches; enabling this is a UX improvement that changes the operator browser security/privacy boundary.

options.title: Keep no-remote-fetch default
options.body: Preserve the current default and require same-origin media, data/blob URLs, or an explicit proxy/opt-in design before rendering remote images.

options.title: Allow direct remote images
options.body: Accept the privacy/tracking tradeoff and update the renderer, sanitizer attributes, CSP, docs, tests, and browser proof together.

options.title: Fold into inline-media policy
options.body: Resolve this focused case through the broader inline-media issue only after that issue explicitly accepts or rejects remote Markdown images.

recommendation.title: Keep no-remote-fetch default
recommendation.body: Preserve the current default and require same-origin media, data/blob URLs, or an explicit proxy/opt-in design before rendering remote images.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily the Control UI browser-fetch/CSP security policy that this owner most directly touched in merged history.
